program_name: Medicine and Surgery (ENG) — Italian official name: Corso di laurea magistrale a ciclo unico in Medicina e Chirurgia in lingua inglese. Single-cycle master's degree (laurea magistrale a ciclo unico), 6 years, 360 CFU, 12 semesters, 34 integrated courses. Delivered by the School of Medicine and Surgery (Scuola di Medicina e Chirurgia), reference department: Dipartimento di Scienze Mediche Traslazionali (DISMET). Course coordinator: Prof. Pasquale Abete (pasquale.abete@unina.it).
level: single-cycle (laurea magistrale a ciclo unico, 6 years / 360 ECTS; the orientamento page labels it 'Single cycle Degree Programme / Master's degree')
teaching_language: English. This is the fully English-taught version of Medicine and Surgery, run in parallel to the Italian-language 'Medicina e Chirurgia' course. Italian B2 is NOT required for admission or pre-enrolment because the programme is English-taught; the university's international pages state for English-taught degrees that 'level B2 Italian language proficiency is not required'. Note that clinical placements take place in Italian-speaking hospital settings, and the School's own site offers both 'COURSES OF ENGLISH LANGUAGE' and 'COURSES OF ITALIAN LANGUAGE' support modules for enrolled students.
campus: Policlinico Federico II (Medical campus) — School of Medicine and Federico II University Hospital, Via Sergio Pansini 5, 80131 Napoli. Student Secretariat: Segreteria Studenti Area Didattica di Medicina e Chirurgia, Via S. Pansini 5, Edificio n. 24. IMPORTANT: the admission test itself is NOT held at Policlinico — the 2026/27 bando sets the Naples test venue as the Complesso Universitario di Monte S. Angelo, via Cinthia, Napoli.
degree_class: LM-41 (Medicina e Chirurgia). Internal Federico II course code on the orientamento portal: P11-DH6. The 2026/27 admission decree refers to the course as 'Medicina e Chirurgia in lingua inglese (LM 41 R)' — the 'R' variant code used in the 2026/27 ministerial programming.
admission_type: Restricted access — national restricted access (Numero Programmato Nazionale) through the single national admission test for ENGLISH-TAUGHT medical degrees, governed by MUR decree D.M. n. 1005/2026 ('Definizione delle modalità e dei contenuti della prova di ammissione ai corsi di laurea magistrale a ciclo unico in Medicina e Chirurgia, Odontoiatria e Protesi Dentaria e Medicina Veterinaria, in lingua inglese - a.a. 2026/27'). This is the IMAT-type national test route. RESOLUTION OF THE CRITICAL OPEN QUESTION: this programme does NOT go through the new national 'semestre filtro / semestre aperto' (Legge 26/2025, D.M. 418/2025 and D.M. 431/2025). The Federico II semestre filtro hub and the university's own 2026/27 filter-semester news list only the ITALIAN-taught courses — Medicina e Chirurgia (LM-41), Medicina e Chirurgia Tecnologica (Napoli and Benevento), Odontoiatria e Protesi Dentaria (LM-46) and Medicina Veterinaria (LM-42) — and never mention 'lingua inglese'. In parallel, Federico II published a separate 2026/27 competitive call (bando) for the English-language course, D.R. n. 3111 of 10/08/2026, that runs an entrance examination on 29 September 2026 with registration on Universitaly, i.e. the classic pre-reform selection route. Applications for both candidate categories (EU/non-EU resident in Italy, and non-EU resident abroad) go through the same single test; the two categories are then ranked in two separate rankings. There is therefore ONE admission route, not a separate 'international track' — but non-EU candidates resident abroad compete in a reserved quota whose ranking is compiled by Federico II itself rather than by CINECA.
academic_requirements: Eligible candidates (art. 2 of the 2026/27 bando): (1) holders of an Italian upper-secondary school leaving diploma (diploma di istruzione secondaria di secondo grado); (2) EU citizens wherever resident and non-EU citizens legally residing in Italy (art. 39 c.5 D.Lgs. 286/1998 as amended by art. 26 L. 189/2002) holding a foreign qualification obtained after at least 12 years of schooling and recognised as equivalent to the Italian secondary diploma; (3) non-EU citizens resident abroad holding a foreign qualification obtained after at least 12 years of schooling and recognised as equivalent, following the MUR 'Procedure per l'ingresso, il soggiorno e l'immatricolazione degli studenti internazionali' valid for a.y. 2026/27 (studiare-in-italia.it). No prior subject-specific university credits are required (it is a single-cycle degree entered from high school). Students transferring from another degree programme or another university, and graduates of other degrees, must sit the same admission test and — per points 12-15 of Annex 2 of D.M. 1005/2026 — can only be enrolled in the FIRST year, because Federico II has no free places in years 2-6 of the existing cohorts. Enrolment above quota ('in sovrannumero') or outside the cohort is never permitted.
language_requirements: NO mandatory English certificate is imposed by the 2026/27 admission call. Key points: (a) The test itself is entirely in English, so English proficiency is tested implicitly. (b) At test registration on Universitaly, candidates DECLARE (self-certification under art. 46 D.P.R. 445/2000) whether they hold one of the English language certifications listed in Annex 3 of D.M. n. 1005/2026; this certification is used ONLY as a tie-breaker if two candidates finish on the same score (after the subject-by-subject tie-breaks). False declarations lead to cancellation of enrolment. (c) Italian language: for English-taught degrees, Federico II's international pages state that B2 Italian is not required, and no Italian language test is imposed for pre-enrolment. (d) For non-EU applicants abroad, Federico II notes that an international English certificate (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge, etc.) is 'useful for the issue of the visa by the diplomatic/consular Representation' — i.e. useful for the embassy, not a university admission requirement. In short: no hard English threshold (no fixed B2/IELTS score) is published by Federico II for this programme for 2026/27.

(2) Requests for disability/SLD (L.104/1992, L.170/2010) accommodations by PEC to area.studenti@pec.unina.it also by 2026-09-09, 15:00. (3) Test date: 2026-09-29. (4) Anonymous scores published by CINECA on Universitaly: 2026-10-08. (5) Candidates can view their own paper and score: 2026-10-19. (6) National nominative merit ranking published on Universitaly: 2026-10-26. (2) Deadline to submit the visa application at Italian Embassies/Consulates: 2026-11-30. (3) Admission-test registration on Universitaly: 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-09, 15:00 (GMT+2) — same single national procedure as EU candidates; non-EU candidates abroad may choose an overseas test venue from Table A of D.M. 1005/2026. (4) Test date: 2026-09-29. (5) Ranking: the ranking for non-EU candidates resident abroad is compiled by Federico II itself (not by CINECA), 'with the same procedures' as the national ranking; the university publishes it on www.unina.it. (6) Enrolment deadline for this category: [uncertain] — the bando states only that non-EU candidates resident abroad must enrol 'by the deadline that will be made known when the relevant ranking is published', in person at the university offices indicated in that publication. As of 2026-08-30 that date is not yet published. (7) After enrolling, the documentation submitted online must be printed and delivered within 15 days to the Segreteria Studenti Area Didattica di Medicina e Chirurgia (Via S. Pansini 5, Building 24).
required_documents:
A. For the admission test (art. 3 and art. 6 of the bando): online registration on Universitaly + payment of the test contribution; on test day the candidate must show (i) a valid photo identity document (ID card, driving licence with photo, passport, etc.) and (ii) the Universitaly test-registration receipt. Candidates with disability/invalidity (L.104/1992) or SLD/DSA (L.170/2010) must send a request plus original or certified copy of the medical certification (DSA diagnosis no older than 3 years or issued after the candidate's 18th birthday) by PEC to area.studenti@pec.unina.it. Foreign-resident candidates with disability/DSA must supply the certification issued in their country of residence with a sworn translation into Italian or English.
B. For enrolment (art. 10 of the bando + Federico II international pages): access to https://www.segrepass1.unina.it/Welcome.do with codice fiscale/password or SPID, 'Accettazione posto in graduatoria', then 'Immatricolazioni ai Corsi di Studio a numero programmato', self-certification of the school qualification and family income (ISEEU), and payment of the first instalment + regional tax (bank transfer and post-office payments are NOT accepted). Foreign-citizenship students must enrol at the Segreteria Studenti counters, not online.
C. Documents for non-EU applicants (international.unina.it): validated Universitaly pre-enrolment summary; copy of passport; enrolment application form; 1 passport photo; Italian tax code (codice fiscale); proof of having applied for the residence permit; foreign qualification documents — translation, legalisation, Diploma Supplement, transcripts, and either a Declaration of Value (DoV) issued by the Italian Embassy or a CIMEA/ENIC-NARIC statement of comparability; health insurance policy for the visa. Federico II explicitly does NOT issue admission letters for visa purposes.
entry_exam_or_test: YES — a written national entrance examination for English-taught medical degrees (the IMAT-type test), identical in content at every test venue in Italy and abroad, governed by D.M. MUR n. 1005/2026 (Annexes 1, 2, 3, Tables A and B). Date: 2026-09-29, starting at 13:30; candidates must be present at 11:30. Naples venue: Complesso Universitario di Monte S. Angelo, via Cinthia, Napoli (room assignment published the same day; candidates distributed by date of birth). No exceptions on test venue are allowed. Format: 60 multiple-choice questions with 5 options each, in 100 minutes: reading comprehension and general knowledge 4, logical reasoning and problems 5, biology 23, chemistry 15, physics and mathematics 13. Scoring: max 90 points; +1.5 per correct answer, -0.40 per wrong answer, 0 for no answer. Minimum score: EU candidates and non-EU candidates legally resident in Italy must reach at least 20 points to be eligible; non-EU candidates resident abroad only need a score above zero (candidates who answer nothing are excluded from the ranking). Tie-breaks in order: biology, chemistry, physics & maths, logical reasoning, reading; then possession of an English certification from Annex 3 of D.M. 1005/2026; then invalidity >=66% or L.104/1992 art.3 c.3 disability; then younger candidate. Papers are processed anonymously by CINECA. The Federico II School of Medicine's own English course website hosts an 'ADMISSION TEST (IMAT)' page pointing to IMAT preparation/past-paper resources, confirming the IMAT route. NOTE: this is a different exam from the semestre filtro/semestre aperto exams (20 November and 10 December sessions) used for the Italian-taught health-area courses.
tuition_or_fees_link: Main pages: https://www.unina.it/en/didattica/tasse-e-simulatore (Taxes and simulator, EN) and https://www.unina.it/it/didattica/iscrizioni-e-tasse (Iscrizioni e tasse, IT). Fee simulator: http://calcolatrice.unina.it/ . Official fee guide for 2026/27: 'Guida all'iscrizione Anno accademico 2026-27' — https://www.unina.it/documents/d/guest/guida_studente_rapida_26-27_10-7-2026 . Summary for 2026/27: first-year students pay an ISEEU-based 'contributo agevolato' — fully exempt up to ISEEU 30,000 EUR; above that a fixed 1,011.50 EUR plus a variable component, up to a maximum of 2,384.00 EUR for those who do not file an ISEEU declaration. On top of that: regional right-to-study tax of 130 / 151 / 173 EUR (151 EUR applies to students whose household resides abroad; 173 EUR for ISEEU above 51,000 EUR or no ISEEU) plus 16.00 EUR stamp duty. Crucially for international students: non-EU citizens are FULLY EXEMPT from the tuition contribution and pay only the regional tax plus stamp duty; citizens of other EU countries pay a flat 200 EUR contribution plus regional tax and stamp duty. The Federico II international page summarises this as 'European students 200 EUR/year (tuition fees) + 140 EUR/year regional tax + 16.00 EUR legal stamp' and 'Non-european students 140 EUR/year regional fee + 16.00 EUR legal stamp' (the 140 EUR figure is the previous year's regional tax; the 2026/27 guide sets 130/151/173 EUR). Instalments 2026/27: 60% + regional tax + stamp due 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-02 (from 2026-07-16 for new enrolments), 20% by 2027-03-01, 20% by 2027-04-30. Separate from university fees, the pre-graduation qualifying internship requires 49.58 EUR (state school tax) + 104.00 EUR (Regione Campania professional qualification fee).

uncertainty_notes:
1) CRITICAL QUESTION RESOLVED (high confidence, official unina.it sources): Medicine and Surgery (ENG) does NOT run through the new 'semestre filtro / semestre aperto' introduced by Legge 26/2025. Evidence: (a) Federico II published a distinct 2026/27 competitive call for this course, D.R. 3111 of 10/08/2026, based on D.M. MUR n. 1005/2026 — a decree written specifically for the English-taught Medicine/Dentistry/Veterinary courses — with an entrance exam on 29 September 2026 and CINECA-processed anonymous papers; (b) the Federico II semestre filtro hub and the university's 2026/27 filter-semester news list only the Italian-taught LM-41 / LM-41 'tecnologica' / LM-46 / LM-42 courses and never mention 'lingua inglese'; (c) the semestre filtro registration window (closed 3 August 2026) and lesson start (1 September 2026) are structurally incompatible with a 29 September 2026 entrance exam; (d) the School of Medicine's own English course website keeps an 'ADMISSION TEST (IMAT)' page. So the 'Numero Programmato Nazionale' wording on the English programme page is still accurate — it just refers to the separate national English-language (IMAT-type) competition, not to the filter semester. No conflicting official unina.it statement was found.
2) SEAT COUNT CONFLICT: the task brief and the orientamento.unina.it page state 70 seats (25 + 45). This is outdated for a.y. 2026/27. The official bando of 10/08/2026 states 80 seats (35 EU/non-EU-resident-in-Italy + 45 non-EU resident abroad), following D.R. n. 2792 of 20.7.2026 which raised the EU/resident-in-Italy quota from 25 to 35 at CRUI's request; Table B of D.M. 1005/2026 confirms 35 + 45. The orientamento page is explicitly labelled 'UPDATED 2025/2026' and has not been refreshed. Figures given here are the 2026/27 ones.
3) NOT A SEPARATE INTERNATIONAL TRACK: non-EU candidates resident abroad do not have a distinct application route — they take the same single national English-language test on the same day. What differs is (i) the reserved 45-seat quota, (ii) the eligibility threshold (score above 0 instead of 20 points), (iii) the ranking being compiled by Federico II rather than CINECA, and (iv) enrolment being done in person at the university offices instead of fully online.
4) NON-EU ENROLMENT DEADLINE UNKNOWN: the bando does not fix a date for non-EU-abroad enrolment; it will be announced together with the university-compiled ranking (expected late October / November 2026). Marked [uncertain] in application_deadline_non_eu.
5) DEGREE CLASS NAMING: the programme page shows 'LM-41 (P11-DH6)'; the 2026/27 decree writes 'LM 41 R'. Both refer to the same course; P11-DH6 is Federico II's internal course code and 'R' is the 2026/27 ministerial programming variant.
6) FEE FIGURES: the international.unina.it summary (200 EUR EU / regional tax 140 EUR) is a simplified, partly stale summary; the binding 2026/27 amounts are in the Guida all'iscrizione 2026-27 (regional tax 130/151/173 EUR, non-EU citizens exempt from the tuition contribution, EU non-Italian citizens flat 200 EUR). Federico II publishes no separate 'international programme' tuition for this course — it uses the standard ISEEU-based system.
7) LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT: no fixed English level (e.g. B2/IELTS 6.0) is published by Federico II for this programme for 2026/27; the certification only breaks ties. Applicants should still expect embassies to ask for an English certificate at the visa stage.
8) All data captured on 2026-08-30, from unina.it / orientamento.unina.it / international.unina.it / medicina.unina.it only. Test registration was open at capture time (26 Aug – 9 Sep 2026), so ranking dates and the non-EU enrolment deadline may still be updated by later Federico II notices published on www.unina.it.
